2. 프로젝트 개요 / Project Overview

MarsLab-core는 Isaac Sim 안에서 Perseverance-class rover, Mars lighting/atmosphere, sensors, ROS 2 bridge, odometry and GT outputs를 담당한다. MarsLab-Utils는 terrain/assets/scenes/trajectories/evaluation을 생성하는 외부 toolchain이다. 이 관계는 top-level README의 MarsLab-Utils 링크와 실행 절차, 그리고 각 유틸리티 README의 package scope에서 확인된다.

MarsLab README evidence

# MarsLab

**Standardized Mars simulation platform for SLAM, autonomous navigation, and
field-robotics research, built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim 5.x.**

MarsLab gives planetary-robotics researchers a single, scriptable, ROS2-native
testbed for repeatable Mars experiments. The runtime consumes a pre-built
external USDA terrain (any HiRISE-derived USD scene authored upstream in
[`MarsLab-Utils`](https://github.com/kimhoyun-robotair/MarsLab-Utils)) plus a
single `configs/default.yaml` describing the Mars atmosphere + lighting, then
spawns the M2020 Perseverance rover with a full ROS2 bridge on top.

* **Reproducible by design** — every randomized process accepts a `seed`; one
  YAML + one `--usda` path = identical output every run.
* **External terrain authoring** — terrain meshes (HiRISE / procedural / cave
  / habitat) are baked into USDA upstream by MarsLab-Utils. MarsLab only
  consumes them, so terrain authoring code (DEM loader, procedural generator,
  rock placer, cave builder, structure loader) no longer lives in this repo.
* **ROS2 Jazzy native** — `cmd_vel`, odometry, IMU, RGB, depth, RGB-D point
  cloud, 3D + 2D LiDAR, full TF tree.
* **Pydantic-validated** — every YAML field is type-checked at load time;
  typos fail loudly before Isaac Sim boots.
* **CLI overrides for experiment variants** — change sun position via
  `--sun-azimuth-deg`/`--sun-elevation-deg`; toggle headless / no-ROS2 /
  no-atmosphere with their respective flags. No YAML edit needed for
  per-experiment tweaks.

**Target paper:** iSpaRo 2026 (regular paper, deadline 2026-06-15).
**License:** Apache 2.0.

TrajectoryComposer README evidence

# TrajectoryComposer

Reference trajectory generators for the HiRISE-derived Mars scenes produced
by `HiRISEGen` and `RockyComposer`. Each generator emits a TUM-format pose
trajectory (`trajectory.tum`), a metadata sidecar (`trajectory.json`), and
two visualizations (`viz_top.png`, `viz_side.png`) into a per-scene directory
under `out/`.

Trajectories are written in the **ROS REP-103 local ENU frame** that matches
the corresponding scene's `terrain_scene.usda` (x = east, y = north,
z = up; origin at DEM center). All trajectories obey the global motion
constraints used elsewhere in the pipeline: `v ≤ 0.5 m/s`,
`|ω| ≤ 0.2 rad/s`, sampled at 50 Hz.

## Layout

```
TrajectoryComposer/
├── src/trajectorycomposer/
│   ├── common.py              # shared DEM / bilinear / TUM IO utilities
│   └── generators/
│       ├── jezero_enhanced.py        # r=50m CCW circle (jezero_enhanced)
│       ├── jezero_rocky.py           # ~200m rock-avoiding straight (jezero_rocky)
│       ├── small_crater_bigger_hq.py # crater-avoidance teardrop loop
│       ├── main_crater_hq.py         # r=75m circle starting at DEM center
│       └── grand_canyon_hq.py        # canyon traversal from DEM center
└── out/<scene>/
    ├── trajectory.tum
    ├── trajectory.json
    ├── viz_top.png

# code-quality-audit — MarsLab 코드 품질 감사 체크리스트

`code-quality-reviewer` 에이전트가 black/ruff 같은 정적 도구가 잡지 못하는 코드 품질·anti-pattern 이슈를 LLM이 직접 소스를 읽어 감사하는 워크플로우.

## Why this matters
black은 포매팅, ruff는 스타일/linting을 잡지만, **설계 결함·의도·도메인 anti-pattern**은 잡지 못한다. MarsLab의 G3/G5/P1/P3 같은 원칙은 LLM이 맥락을 이해해야 검출 가능하다. 이 스킬은 그 검출을 체계화한다.

# dem-scenario-builder — MarsLab Scenario YAML 생성 파이프라인

MarsLab의 7개 mission scenario(Basic Mars, Rock-Dense, Crater+Slopes, Canyon, Cave, Spacecraft Landing, Mars Base) YAML을 일관되게 생성·검증·시각화하는 워크플로우.

## Why this matters
각 scenario는 DEM 크롭, 암석 SFD, 조명, 에셋 배치, 로버 스폰을 일관된 YAML로 표현해야 한다. Python에 하드코딩하면 G5 위반이고, scenario 간 비교·재현이 어려워진다. 이 스킬은 7개 scenario를 동일한 패턴으로 빠르게 생성하고 오프라인 시각화로 검증한다.

# dynamic-atmosphere-update — MarsLab 동적 대기 갱신

MarsLab v1.0의 dynamic atmosphere(Wk3·Wk5)를 구현·검증하는 워크플로우. Sun position·dust opacity τ·fog가 런타임에 일관되게 갱신되도록 한다.

## Why this matters
정적 sky·sun으로는 SLAM 견고성, 그림자 변화, τ 영향 평가가 불가능하다. v1.0의 차별점 중 하나가 "dynamic atmosphere + SLAM/Nav 평가"이므로(PLAN.md §1), τ ∈ {0.3, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0} 4단계와 time-of-sol sun 위치를 런타임에 안정적으로 변경할 수 있어야 한다. Beer's law·COMIMART 식은 NASA 참조값과 5% 이내 정확도를 유지해야 한다.

# paper-figure-capture — MarsLab iSpaRo 2026 논문 Figure 생성

Wk6의 벤치마크 데이터와 7개 scenario를 iSpaRo 2026 논문에 들어갈 figure로 변환하는 워크플로우. 8 page Regular Paper 분량을 고려하여 figure 수와 정보 밀도를 균형 있게 관리한다.

## Why this matters
논문에 들어갈 figure는 (a) 정확하고, (b) 재현 가능하고, (c) IEEE 양식에 맞아야 한다. 즉흥 스크린샷은 마감 직전 재캡처 비용이 크다. 이 스킬은 figure를 데이터 기반으로 자동 생성하고, Isaac Sim이 필요한 부분만 사용자 실행으로 분리한다.

# ros2-bridge-verification — MarsLab ROS2 브리지 검증

MarsLab의 `marslab/ros2_bridge/` 모듈이 Isaac Sim과 ROS2 간 데이터를 정확하고 일관된 레이트로 주고받는지 검증하는 워크플로우. Wk2 cmd_vel/TF/odometry 신규 구현 + Wk3 SLAM 통합의 전제 조건.

## Why this matters
ROS2 브리지의 버그는 다운스트림 SLAM·Nav2가 통째로 실패하게 만든다. 토픽이 "보이는데" 실제 데이터 shape이 잘못되거나 레이트가 명세보다 낮으면 SLAM 맵이 발산한다. 단순 `ros2 topic list`로 존재만 확인하는 것은 충분하지 않다 — **shape·rate·TF 체인 일관성**까지 검증해야 한다.

# urdf-physics-tuning — MarsLab Rover URDF 물리 안정화

MarsLab v1.0 Week 1의 **THE critical task**: rover URDF를 `fix_base=False` 하에서 Mars 중력(3.72 m/s²) 지형 위에 안정적으로 안착시키고 주행 가능하게 만드는 워크플로우.

## Why this matters
Foundation(Wk1~9 구 일정)에서 rover는 `fix_base=True`로 정적 배치만 확인했다. 동적 물리로 전환 시 모멘트·충돌·관절 한계 오류로 즉시 튀거나 관통·진동이 발생한다. `run_scene.py`와 `mars_env.yaml`에서 로봇 스폰이 주석 처리된 것은 이 이슈가 해결되지 않아서다. 이 스킬은 그 디버깅을 체계화한다.

5. HiRISEGen / Subsystem Chapter

목적 / Purpose

HiRISE/GeoTIFF DEM을 crop/resample/mesh/texture/USD scene으로 변환하는 terrain preparation package.

README evidence

MarsLab-Utils/HiRISEGen/README.md
# HiRISEGen

HiRISEGen converts HiRISE/Jezero DEM GeoTIFF terrain into Isaac Sim-compatible USD terrain scenes.

## Install

From the project root:

```bash
cd ~/MarsLab-Utils/HiRISEGen
python3.12 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -U pip
python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

Check that the CLI is available:

```bash
hirisegen --help
```

## Configure

Edit the main example config:

```text
examples/config_jezero_mvp.yaml
```
MarsLab-Utils/HiRISEGen/tmp/README.md
# HiRISEGen PDS3→USDA Terrain Pipeline (`tmp/`)

A thin wrapper around the existing HiRISEGen pipeline that accepts raw
PDS3 HiRISE DTM and orthomosaic files as inputs, converts them to
GeoTIFF, and delegates the full terrain export to
`hirisegen.pipeline.run_export()`.

---

## File Map

```
HiRISEGen/tmp/
├── README.md                  — this file
├── __init__.py                — makes tmp a Python package
├── cli.py                     — Typer CLI (convert / export sub-commands)
├── pds_to_geotiff.py          — PDS3/JP2+LBL → cached GeoTIFF helpers
├── config_large_crater.yaml   — pipeline config for the Large Crater dataset
├── cache/                     — runtime output dir for cached GeoTIFFs
│   └── .gitignore             — ignores everything except itself
└── tests/
    ├── __init__.py
    └── test_pds_ingest.py     — pytest tests (fast + one slow integration test)
```

---

README evidence

MarsLab-Utils/synthterrain/README.md
# synthterrain — Mars Specialization Fork

This is a personal fork of [NeoGeographyToolkit/synthterrain](https://github.com/NeoGeographyToolkit/synthterrain) (Apache-2.0), extended to produce **Mars-specialized synthetic rock populations** using the Golombek-Huertas (2008) size-frequency distribution.

The full upstream project description, build setup, license headers, and contributor docs live in [`README.rst`](./README.rst). This file documents only the Mars specialization layered on top.

---

## What's new in this fork

### `Golombek_2008` rock size-frequency distribution

A new `synthterrain.rock.functions.Golombek_2008` class implements the Mars rock SFD from:

> Golombek, M., Huertas, A., Marlow, J., et al. (2008).
> *"Size-frequency distributions of rocks on the northern plains of Mars with special reference to Phoenix landing surfaces."*
> Icarus 200, 52-76.

Functional form (retained from Golombek & Rapp 1997, JGR 102, 4117-4129):

```
q(k)    = 1.79 + 0.152 / k
cfa(D)  = k · exp(-q · D)                  [cumulative area-fraction]
csfd(D) = (4 · q · k · E_2(q · D)) / (π · D)   [count per square meter]
```

where `E_2 = scipy.special.expn(2, ·)` is the generalized exponential integral.

The class exposes both forms:
- `cfa(D)` — paper-literal area-fraction, for direct comparison to Golombek 2008 figures.

핵심 알고리즘 & 수식 / Core algorithms & formulas

Crater CSFD base CDF

CDF(d)=1-CSFD(d)/CSFD(d_min). Evidence: MarsLab-Utils/synthterrain/src/python/synthterrain/crater/functions.py:119-138.

Crater diffusion

diffusion degradation. Evidence: MarsLab-Utils/synthterrain/src/python/synthterrain/crater/diffusion.py:107-240 (함수 diffuse_d_over_D; 마지막 return dd가 240줄).

Crater profile (Watters2015_Crater.profile)

radial profile. Evidence: MarsLab-Utils/synthterrain/src/python/synthterrain/crater/profile.py:390-429 (클래스 Watters2015_Crater, 정의 시작 370줄).

Rock Golombek SFD

csfd(D)=4qkE2(qD)/(piD). Evidence: MarsLab-Utils/synthterrain/src/python/synthterrain/rock/functions.py:105-109.

7. CraterComposer / Subsystem Chapter

목적 / Purpose

HiRISEGen scene 위에 synthterrain crater catalog/profile을 적용해 cratered DEM/USD artifacts를 생성하는 composer.

README evidence

MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/README.md
# CraterComposer

Compose a synthterrain crater field onto a HiRISEGen DEM and write an Isaac Sim-compatible USDA terrain scene.

## Usage

```bash
crater-compose --config examples/compose_small_dense.yaml
```

## Setup

```bash
python3.12 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]'
```

- **50 m ≤ D < 1 km** → `Watters2015_Crater` (small Mars craters), d/D = 0.175MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/REPORT.md:82
- **`Hartmann_Neukum_2001` requires `a ≥ 10`**: Documented constraint from Neukum 2001 valid range. CraterComposer falls back to power-law for `min_diameter_m < 10`.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/REPORT.md:137
- **Caveat**: Hartmann's "isochron" approach (Hartmann 2005, Icarus 174) uses DIFFERENT coefficients than Neukum 2001. Our implementation explicitly follows the **Neukum side** of H&N 2001 (the joint paper presents both Hartmann's isochrons and Neukum's polynomial). The docstring notes the two approaches "agree within ~10 percent" per H&N 2001 Fig. 6.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/SCIENTIFIC_VERIFICATION.md:86
- **Central peak**: For D ≥ ~7 km Mars craters transition from simple bowl to complex (with central peak). Implementation uses bowl polynomial for ALL D. For the user's scene generation (max D ~100 m in Scene B), this is irrelevant — all craters are well below the simple-to-complex transition (~7 km on Mars per Robbins & Hynek 2012 Paper 2).MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/SCIENTIFIC_VERIFICATION.md:45
- **Crater diffusion / aging not applied**: CraterComposer uses fresh crater profiles only. To add age-dependent degradation, integrate `synthterrain.crater.diffusion.diffuse_d_over_D` with `crater_cls=Watters2015_Crater` etc. (synthterrain's `diffuse_d_over_D_by_bin` does not currently accept `crater_cls` — would need a minor patch).MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/REPORT.md:149

- **메인 CSFD**: `Hartmann_Neukum_2001`이 직경 D ∈ [10 m, 300 km] 범위에서 누적 SFD `N(>D)`를 계산합니다. 이는 Neukum 2001 (H&N 2001 §2.2에서 인용) Table 1의 12개 다항식 계수를 사용하며, `a0 = -3.076756` 값은 craterstats 커뮤니티에서 정정된 오자(`-3.0768`)를 반영한 형태입니다.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/Reference.md:68
- **보충 참고문헌**: Hartmann (2005, *Icarus* **174**, 294–320, [10.1016/j.icarus.2004.11.023](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.icarus.2004.11.023)) — D < 10 m 영역의 equilibrium power-law fallback에 인용MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/Reference.md:52
- **사용 범위**: Neukum 12-term log–log production polynomial을 화성 표면 CSFD로 적용 (D ∈ [10 m, 300 km])MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/Reference.md:50
- **소형 영역 (D < 10 m)**: H&N 2001 다항식의 정의역 밖이므로 Hartmann (2005)의 화성 equilibrium SFD 형태인 power-law `N(>D) ∝ D^(-2)` (b = 2.0)로 외삽합니다. 베이스라인 밀도는 시각적 procedural terrain용으로 500/km² 으로 잡고, 사용자 `density_multiplier` 으로 스케일합니다. 이는 pipeline.py 안에 명시적으로 주석으로 기록되어 있어 학술적 인용 한계가 분명히 드러납니다.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/Reference.md:70
- **재형성 옵션**: `Michael_Neukum_2010`이 위 메인 CSFD를 상속하면서 `resurfacing_diameter` 미만의 직경에서 csfd를 0으로 만듭니다. 임의 연령의 표면을 모사할 때 사용합니다.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/Reference.md:69

- 0.225 is at the upper end of the fresh-impact d/D range. Daubar & McEwen 2009 surveyed 19 new HiRISE impact sites with measured d/D averaging ~0.20. Using 0.225 emphasizes the "very fresh" interpretation, which aligns with the user's selection of this paper as the fallback for D < 50 m.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/SCIENTIFIC_VERIFICATION.md:65
- `Hartmann_Neukum_2001(a=10, b=100).count(2.25e6 m²) = 8543` — 1.5 km × 1.5 km 타일에서 신선 10–100 m 크레이터 수가 화성 평형 인구의 적절한 차수 (order-of-magnitude) 안에 들어옴을 확인했습니다.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/Reference.md:176
- `Hartmann_Neukum_2001`은 `Coef_Distribution`(scipy `rv_continuous` 기반)을 상속하고, `_a0..a11` 계수를 클래스 상수로 보유합니다. 정의역은 a ≥ 10 m, b ≤ 300 km로 강제됩니다 (`__init__`에서 ValueError).MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/Reference.md:103
- `Michael_Neukum_2010`은 `Hartmann_Neukum_2001`을 상속하고 `csfd(d)` 메서드에서 `d < resurfacing_diameter` 인 부분만 0으로 mask 합니다.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/Reference.md:104
- d/D values are population midpoints (sensible default). For "fresh-only" craters, Robbins & Hynek 2012 Fig. 13 shows d/D up to 0.20+, but the population average is lower due to degradation.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/SCIENTIFIC_VERIFICATION.md:44
- Docstring has a typo in paper title (`JGR Planets 120, 1leware` should be page numbers); cosmetic only.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/SCIENTIFIC_VERIFICATION.md:22
- For D < 10 m, **the H&N 2001 polynomial is not defined** — pipeline falls back to a Hartmann (2005) Mars equilibrium power-law N(>D) ∝ D⁻² (b = 2.0) with a 500/km² baseline density. This is documented inline in `pipeline.py`.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/SCIENTIFIC_VERIFICATION.md:87
- For Scene A (D = 0.5 – 5 m), all craters use `DaubarMcEwen2009_Crater` (the most fresh-impact model).MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/SCIENTIFIC_VERIFICATION.md:127
- For Scene B (D = 10 – 100 m), 4255 use Daubar–McEwen and 17 use Watters 2015 (D ≥ 50 m).MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/SCIENTIFIC_VERIFICATION.md:128
- Hartmann & Neukum 2001 use Neukum's polynomial fit for the Mars Production Function (MPF). Our `Hartmann_Neukum_2001` class uses the **same polynomial coefficients as the lunar NPF** (lines 471–488 of `Coef_Distribution`). This is scientifically defensible because Neukum's MPF and LPF polynomials share identical coefficients in the "log–log production rate" form (the difference between Moon and Mars is in the chronology calibration, not the polynomial shape). H&N 2001 Section 2.2 explicitly applies the Neukum production polynomial to Mars with this assumption.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/SCIENTIFIC_VERIFICATION.md:85
- Profile shape reuses F&T 2014 polynomial structure, rescaled so floor = d/D − rim and rim peak = H_rim/D. This is **shape-faithful** to the standard Mars small-crater morphology (Watters does not publish closed-form polynomial; F&T 2014 polynomial is the field standard for bowl-shaped craters with rim).MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/SCIENTIFIC_VERIFICATION.md:21
- Scene A (D=0.5–5 m, 5625 craters): 전부 `DaubarMcEwen2009_Crater` 사용 → 라우팅 정확MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/Reference.md:177
- Scene B (D=10–100 m, 4272 craters): 4255개 Daubar, 17개 Watters (D ≥ 50 m 경계 통과분) → 라우팅 정확MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/Reference.md:178
- 후처리로 `new_z_reference = min(cratered_dem)` 을 계산하고 `min_zero` normalization을 재적용하여 ROS REP-103 Local ENU 규약과 HiRISEGen schema (`elevation.z_reference_mode = min_zero`) 를 그대로 유지합니다.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/Reference.md:145

The Hartmann–Neukum production function is undefined below D = 10 m (paper constraint, enforced as `ValueError`). For Scene A (D = 0.5–5 m) the CraterComposer pipeline falls back to a **Hartmann (2005) Mars equilibrium power-law** N(>D) ∝ D⁻² (b = 2.0), scaled to ~500 craters/km² baseline × user `density_multiplier`. This is explicitly documented inline in `pipeline.py`. The morphology (DaubarMcEwen2009 profile) remains paper-grounded.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/REPORT.md:115

8. RockAssetGen / Subsystem Chapter

목적 / Purpose

GLB atlas와 NASA Astromaterials scan sources에서 reusable rock USD asset library를 만드는 asset generator.

README evidence

MarsLab-Utils/RockAssetGen/README.md
# RockAssetGen

## Overview

RockAssetGen builds an Isaac Sim-compatible USDA rock-asset library from two
complementary sources: a GLB atlas of Mars rock meshes (UV + baseColor
preserved as-is) and NASA Astromaterials 3-D scan samples.  For each
Astromaterials rock the pipeline runs Blender 4.0+ headless to decimate the
high-poly scan, apply Smart-UV Project, and bake a Cycles tangent-space normal
map from high to low.  Albedo textures for Astromaterials rocks are assigned
from the GLB atlas via mean-luminance spacing so the palette spans the full
colour range.  Every rock is written as a standalone prototype USDA
(`rock_001.usda` … `rock_NNN.usda`), and all prototypes are collected into a
single `rock_library.usda` that RockyComposer and other downstream tools
consume directly.

## Install

From this directory:

```bash
python -m pip install -e .
```

**External dependency — Blender 4.0+**: the Astromaterials branch of the
pipeline invokes Blender headless for decimation, UV unwrap, and normal baking.
`blender` must be on `$PATH`, or the environment variable `$BLENDER` must point
to the executable:

```bash

README evidence

MarsLab-Utils/RockyComposer/README.md
# RockyComposer

## Overview

RockyComposer composes a synthterrain rock CSV, a HiRISEGen DEM output
directory, and a RockAssetGen 15-prototype rock library into a single Isaac
Sim-compatible USDA scene.

The pipeline handles the full end-to-end workflow: CSV ingestion and bbox
validation, DEM Z-sampling via rasterio, prototype selection and scale
clamping, random stable-pose orientation, HiRISEGen Local ENU frame
coordinate transform, USDA scene authoring, and sidecar metadata generation.

## Install

From this directory:

```bash
python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

## Usage

Run the CLI with a compose config:

```bash
rocky-compose --config examples/compose_mvp.yaml
```

Several ready-to-use configs are provided under `examples/`. For example, to

### 1.3 VIPER-MSE-SPEC-001 (2021) — 달(VIPER) 환경 SFD (대조 모델)MarsLab-Utils/RockyComposer/Reference.md:37
- **Date**: 2021-09-16 (NASA VIPER mission)MarsLab-Utils/RockyComposer/Reference.md:39
- **DOI**: [10.1016/j.icarus.2008.10.024](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.icarus.2008.10.024)MarsLab-Utils/RockyComposer/Reference.md:26
- **DOI**: [10.1029/96JE03319](https://doi.org/10.1029/96JE03319)MarsLab-Utils/RockyComposer/Reference.md:33
- **Golombek 2008 cumulative fractional area 모델**MarsLab-Utils/RockyComposer/Reference.md:57
- **Journal**: Icarus, **200**, 52–76 (2008)MarsLab-Utils/RockyComposer/Reference.md:25
- **Title**: *VIPER Environmental Specification, VIPER-MSE-SPEC-001*MarsLab-Utils/RockyComposer/Reference.md:38
- **VIPER 대조군**: `VIPER_Env_Spec`은 동일 인터페이스로 호출 가능하지만 `k`를 받지 않으며 달 환경용. Mars-only scene 합성에서는 사용하지 않습니다.MarsLab-Utils/RockyComposer/Reference.md:64
- **사용 범위**: `q(k) = 1.79 + 0.152/k` 함수 형태 — Golombek 2008이 그대로 계승하여 사용. **Golombek_2008 클래스의 `q(k)` 헬퍼가 이 파라미터화에 직접 대응**합니다.MarsLab-Utils/RockyComposer/Reference.md:34
- **사용 범위**: 형태 `N_cum = 0.0003 · D^(−2.482)` — VIPER 미션 명세에서 사용하는 누적 SFD. 달/Moon 환경 대조군 / cross-check 용으로 제공됨 (Mars 작업에서는 비활성 옵션).MarsLab-Utils/RockyComposer/Reference.md:40
- **주의**: 본 명세서는 별도 학술 인용을 제공하지 않으며, 기본 사용은 Mars Golombek_2008.MarsLab-Utils/RockyComposer/Reference.md:42
- **코드 위치**: `synthterrain/src/python/synthterrain/rock/functions.py:42` (`VIPER_Env_Spec`)MarsLab-Utils/RockyComposer/Reference.md:41
- **코드 위치**: `synthterrain/src/python/synthterrain/rock/functions.py:67` (`golombek_2008_q`)MarsLab-Utils/RockyComposer/Reference.md:35

10. HabitatGen / Subsystem Chapter

목적 / Purpose

Habitat GLB/USD asset generation and flatness-aware habitat placement/composition.

README evidence

MarsLab-Utils/HabitatGen/README.md
# HabitatGen

Generate Mars habitat environments from HiRISE DEMs and 3D asset libraries.

## Overview

HabitatGen produces Isaac Sim-ready USD scenes by composing:
- Per-material USDA rock/terrain assets (via GLB extraction)
- HiRISE elevation data from HiRISEGen
- Procedural placement and authoring pipelines

## CLI Entry Points

### habitat-build

Extract per-material USDA assets from a GLB file:

```bash
habitat-build --input data/mars_base.glb --output out/assets/
```

### habitat-compose

Compose a full habitat scene from a YAML config:

```bash
habitat-compose --config examples/compose_habitat.yaml --output out/scene.usda
```

## Installation

정정 / Correction: 위 README의 habitat-compose --config … --output out/scene.usda 명령은 stale하다 — 실제 compose CLI(MarsLab-Utils/HabitatGen/src/habitatgen/composer/cli.py:10)는 --config 인자만 받으며, --output을 주면 unrecognized arguments: --output 오류가 난다. (--output 플래그는 별도 명령 habitat-build에만 존재한다.)

Materials use UsdPreviewSurface with diffuseColor texture and fixed roughness=0.5 / metallic=0.0.

11. TrajectoryComposer / Subsystem Chapter

목적 / Purpose

Scene DEM/metadata/rock masks를 읽어 reference TUM trajectory, metadata, visualizations를 생성한다.

README evidence

MarsLab-Utils/TrajectoryComposer/README.md
# TrajectoryComposer

Reference trajectory generators for the HiRISE-derived Mars scenes produced
by `HiRISEGen` and `RockyComposer`. Each generator emits a TUM-format pose
trajectory (`trajectory.tum`), a metadata sidecar (`trajectory.json`), and
two visualizations (`viz_top.png`, `viz_side.png`) into a per-scene directory
under `out/`.

Trajectories are written in the **ROS REP-103 local ENU frame** that matches
the corresponding scene's `terrain_scene.usda` (x = east, y = north,
z = up; origin at DEM center). All trajectories obey the global motion
constraints used elsewhere in the pipeline: `v ≤ 0.5 m/s`,
`|ω| ≤ 0.2 rad/s`, sampled at 50 Hz.

## Layout

```
TrajectoryComposer/
├── src/trajectorycomposer/
│   ├── common.py              # shared DEM / bilinear / TUM IO utilities
│   └── generators/
│       ├── jezero_enhanced.py        # r=50m CCW circle (jezero_enhanced)
│       ├── jezero_rocky.py           # ~200m rock-avoiding straight (jezero_rocky)
│       ├── small_crater_bigger_hq.py # crater-avoidance teardrop loop
│       ├── main_crater_hq.py         # r=75m circle starting at DEM center
│       └── grand_canyon_hq.py        # canyon traversal from DEM center
└── out/<scene>/
    ├── trajectory.tum
    ├── trajectory.json
    ├── viz_top.png

정정 / Correction: 위 README의 ## Layout 블록은 stale하다 — jezero_enhanced.py, jezero_rocky.py, small_crater_bigger_hq.py, main_crater_hq.py, grand_canyon_hq.py는 현재 저장소에 존재하지 않는다. 실제 generators/ 파일(아래 "구현된 기능 전체" 표 및 §15 알고리즘 부록 참조): _rocky_loop_common.py, grand_canyon_hq_e2e.py, grand_canyon_hq_stadium.py, jezero_crater_mid_sparse_outer.py, jezero_crater_mid_sparse_rocky_loop.py, jezero_crater_small_dense_rocky_loop.py, jezero_enhanced_test_zigzag.py, jezero_habitat_ellipse_orbit.py, jezero_habitat_perimeter.py, jezero_rocky_loop.py, main_crater_hq_rocky_loop.py, procedural_flatland_rocky_loop.py. (출처 / source: MarsLab-Utils/TrajectoryComposer/src/trajectorycomposer/generators/)

Bilinear DEM interpolation

bilinear interpolation. Evidence: MarsLab-Utils/TrajectoryComposer/src/trajectorycomposer/common.py:109-136.

Safety mask

slope + rock inflation. Evidence: MarsLab-Utils/TrajectoryComposer/src/trajectorycomposer/generators/_rocky_loop_common.py:82-141.

A* search

g/h/f grid planning. Evidence: MarsLab-Utils/TrajectoryComposer/src/trajectorycomposer/generators/_rocky_loop_common.py:147-183.

Arc blending

R_min smoothing. Evidence: MarsLab-Utils/TrajectoryComposer/src/trajectorycomposer/generators/_rocky_loop_common.py:272-409.

50 Hz resampling

constant-speed samples. Evidence: MarsLab-Utils/TrajectoryComposer/src/trajectorycomposer/generators/_rocky_loop_common.py:438-451.

12. PathFollower / Subsystem Chapter

목적 / Purpose

TUM trajectory를 ROS 2 Path로 publish하고 pure-pursuit로 `/rover/cmd_vel`을 생성한다.

README evidence

MarsLab-Utils/PathFollower/README.md
# PathFollower

Pure-pursuit path follower for the MarsLab M2020 rover in Isaac Sim.

Loads a TUM trajectory file, publishes it once as `nav_msgs/Path` (TRANSIENT_LOCAL),
then runs a pure-pursuit control loop that subscribes to the rover's pose and
publishes `geometry_msgs/Twist` on `/rover/cmd_vel`.

Extracted from `SlamBench/` — contains only the path-following components.
ATE evaluation lives in `TUMEvaluation/`.

## Install

```bash
pip install -e /home/hoyunkim/MarsLab-Utils/PathFollower
```

## Run

```bash
python -m pathfollower \
    --trajectory /home/hoyunkim/MarsLab-Utils/TrajectoryComposer/out/jezero_enhanced/trajectory.tum
```

Default pose feedback topic is `/rover/GT_Trajectory` (`nav_msgs/Odometry`).
The rover must be spawned at the trajectory start via `rover_m2020.yaml`:

```yaml
spawn:
  mode: trajectory_start

핵심 알고리즘 & 수식 / Core algorithms & formulas

Cumulative arc

polyline arc length. Evidence: MarsLab-Utils/PathFollower/src/pathfollower/pure_pursuit.py:14-20.

Pure pursuit curvature

kappa=2*y/L^2; omega=v*kappa. Evidence: MarsLab-Utils/PathFollower/src/pathfollower/pure_pursuit.py:23-31.

Lookahead advance

walk to lookahead distance. Evidence: MarsLab-Utils/PathFollower/src/pathfollower/pure_pursuit.py:34-55.

13. TUMEvaluation / Subsystem Chapter

목적 / Purpose

GT odometry를 TUM format으로 dump하고 evo CLI wrapper로 ATE/RPE/trajectory visualization을 수행한다.

README evidence

MarsLab-Utils/TUMEvaluation/README.md
# TUMEvaluation

GT TUM trajectory dumper and ATE evaluation toolkit for the MarsLab M2020 rover.

Uses [`evo`](https://github.com/MichaelGrupp/evo) as the authoritative ATE evaluator.
The `dump-gt` subcommand runs a live ROS 2 node that captures `/rover/GT_Trajectory`
to a TUM file during the simulation. The `evaluate`, `visualize`, and `from-bag`
subcommands are offline tools that wrap `evo_ape`, `evo_traj`, and `evo_res`.

## Install

```bash
pip install -e /home/hoyunkim/MarsLab-Utils/TUMEvaluation
# installs numpy and evo; rclpy/nav_msgs come from the ROS 2 runtime
```

## Subcommands

### dump-gt — Live GT TUM writer

Run while MarsLab is running to capture the ground-truth trajectory:

```bash
python -m tumevaluation dump-gt \
    --topic /rover/GT_Trajectory \
    --output gt.tum
```

Press Ctrl+C to stop. The node appends one TUM line per message and flushes
immediately, so the file is safe even on abrupt termination.

![](./docs/m20-urdf-banner.png)

M2020 Perseverance Rover and Helicopter URDF models used for operations visualization. Models courtesy of the Mars 2020 Perseverance and Ingenuity teams and URDF conversion by JPL RSVP team.

This work was carried out at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, California Institute of Technology, under a contract with the National Aeronautics and Space Administration

Released June 10th, 2022

Release Ids URS307049, URS309682

Credit NASA/JPL-Caltech

Rover modeling and texturing by Zareh Gorjian

핵심 알고리즘 & 수식 / Core algorithms & formulas

Sun position

Mars solar geometry. Evidence: MarsLab/marslab/environment/sun_position.py:74-97.

Light intensity

Beer-law irradiance. Evidence: MarsLab/marslab/environment/light_intensity.py:49-91.

Diffuse fraction

tau-driven diffuse approximation. Evidence: MarsLab/marslab/environment/diffuse_fraction.py:61-98.

Sky dome

dome color/exposure model. Evidence: MarsLab/marslab/environment/sky_dome.py:36-92.

Quaternion helpers

URDF/ROS ZYX roll-pitch-yaw quaternion. Evidence: MarsLab/marslab/quaternion.py:147-171.

Odometry math

world velocity to body-frame twist. Evidence: MarsLab/marslab/ros2_bridge/odometry_math.py:67-91.

Wheel odometry

wheel odometry publisher. Evidence: MarsLab/marslab/ros2_bridge/wheel_odometry_publisher.py:105-165.

GT odometry

ground-truth odometry publisher. Evidence: MarsLab/marslab/ros2_bridge/odometry_publisher.py:155-205.

MarsLab/.claude/agents/code-quality-reviewer.md:3description: "MarsLab 코드 품질·보안 자체 검토. black/ruff 같은 정적 도구가 잡지 못하는 설계·보안·anti-pattern 이슈를 LLM이 직접 소스를 읽어 감사. 가독성, 함수 복잡도, dead code, docstring, 타입 힌트 일관성, subprocess shell=True, yaml.load vs safe_load, pickle.load, 경로 traversal, 하드코딩 비밀, Mars 파라미터 하드코딩(G5), OmniLRS/RLRoverLab 네이밍(G3), 폐기 API(omni.isaac.orbit), bare except, silent swallow, seed 누락, 코드 삭제(주석 처리 원칙 위반) 점검. 매 모듈/작업 완료 직후 incremental 리뷰 + 주차 종합 리포트. 코드 리뷰·보안 검토·anti-pattern 감사 요청 시 사용."

MarsLab/.claude/skills/ros2-bridge-verification/SKILL.md:8MarsLab의 `marslab/ros2_bridge/` 모듈이 Isaac Sim과 ROS2 간 데이터를 정확하고 일관된 레이트로 주고받는지 검증하는 워크플로우. Wk2 cmd_vel/TF/odometry 신규 구현 + Wk3 SLAM 통합의 전제 조건.
MarsLab/.claude/skills/ros2-bridge-verification/SKILL.md:11ROS2 브리지의 버그는 다운스트림 SLAM·Nav2가 통째로 실패하게 만든다. 토픽이 "보이는데" 실제 데이터 shape이 잘못되거나 레이트가 명세보다 낮으면 SLAM 맵이 발산한다. 단순 `ros2 topic list`로 존재만 확인하는 것은 충분하지 않다 — **shape·rate·TF 체인 일관성**까지 검증해야 한다.

15. 알고리즘 상세 부록 / Algorithm Deep-Dive Appendix

각 항목은 formula → real code → repository source note 순서이다.

DEM bilinear interpolation

DEM grid cell의 fractional coordinate를 계산하고 four-neighbor weighted sum을 반환한다.

Bilinear interpolation
z=z00(1-f_x)(1-f_y)+z10f_x(1-f_y)+z01(1-f_x)f_y+z11f_xf_y
Plaintext: z=(z00(1-fx)(1-fy)+z10 fx(1-fy)+z01(1-fx)fy+z11 fx fy)

Source / 출처: 출처가 저장소에 명시되지 않음 / No formal citation given in repository

A* search with g/h/f

Repository code uses 8-connected grid neighbors, a heap priority queue, g cost, Euclidean h, and f=g+h.

A* / Dijkstra-like grid planning
gnew=g[current]+step_cost;h=Δr2+Δc2;f=gnew+h
Plaintext: g_new = g[current] + step_cost; h = hypot(goal-row, goal-col); f = g_new + h

Source / 출처: 출처가 저장소에 명시되지 않음 / No formal citation given in repository

Path/arc smoothing

TrajectoryComposer blends corners with a minimum turn radius derived from velocity and yaw-rate limits.

Arc radius constraint
Rmin=VmaxWmax
Plaintext: R_min = V_MAX / W_MAX

함수 전체는 소스 부록의 MarsLab-Utils/TrajectoryComposer/src/trajectorycomposer/generators/_rocky_loop_common.py:272-409에 포함되어 있다.

Source / 출처: 출처가 저장소에 명시되지 않음 / No formal citation given in repository

Rover kinematic constraints

The verifier checks slope, rock clearance, and omega bound against constants in the generator common module.

Yaw-rate verification
ω=diff(unwrap(yaw))DT
Plaintext: omega = diff(unwrap(yaw)) / DT

Source / 출처: 출처가 저장소에 명시되지 않음 / No formal citation given in repository

Rock/obstacle avoidance and inflation

Safety mask construction combines slope thresholding with rock/extra-obstacle dilation.

Obstacle inflation
safe=slopeOK∧¬dilatedObstacle
Plaintext: safe = slope_ok AND not dilated_obstacle

Source / 출처: 출처가 저장소에 명시되지 않음 / No formal citation given in repository

Waypoint resampling

Segments are sampled into fixed-rate trajectory arrays.

Constant-speed timing
ti=iDT;s=Vmaxt
Plaintext: t_i = i * DT; distance = V_MAX * t

Source / 출처: 출처가 저장소에 명시되지 않음 / No formal citation given in repository

Pure pursuit lookahead and curvature

Pure-pursuit math helper computes curvature and angular velocity from the body-frame lookahead point.

Pure pursuit
κ=2ybLactual2;ω=vκ
Plaintext: kappa = 2*y_b/L_actual^2; omega = v*kappa

Source / 출처: 출처가 저장소에 명시되지 않음 / No formal citation given in repository

Crater CSFD and CDF relation

Crater_rv_continuous maps CSFD to statistical CDF using the lower support bound.

Crater CDF from CSFD
CDF(d)=1-CSFD(d)CSFD(dmin)
Plaintext: CDF(d)=1-CSFD(d)/CSFD(d_min)

Source / 출처: Robbins et al. 2018 DOI appears in synthterrain/crater/functions.py docstrings.

Crater diffusion degradation

Diffusion helper numerically degrades crater topography.

Diffusion operator
znext=z+k∇²zdt
Plaintext: z_next = z + k * laplacian(z) * dt

함수 전체는 소스 부록의 MarsLab-Utils/synthterrain/src/python/synthterrain/crater/diffusion.py:107-240에 포함되어 있다.

Source / 출처: See synthterrain crater diffusion docstrings and CraterComposer references; if no formal paper is named for a specific helper, use the repository marker.

Rock SFD

Golombek_2008 implements a Mars rock count-per-square-meter CSFD form.

Golombek rock SFD derived count form
csfd(D)=4qkE2(qD)πD,q(k)=1.79+0.152k
Plaintext: csfd(D)=(4*q*k*E_2(qD))/(pi*D), q(k)=1.79+0.152/k

Source / 출처: Golombek 2008 and Golombek & Rapp 1997 are named in synthterrain/rock/functions.py docstring.

Mars sun position

Computes Mars sun position/direction for environment rendering.

Sun vector
s→=f(azimuth,elevation,distance)
Plaintext: position = function(azimuth, elevation, distance)

Source / 출처: References are listed in MarsLab/marslab/environment/sun_position.py docstring.

Mars light intensity

Direct normal irradiance uses a Mars optical-air-mass and Beer-law form.

Mars direct irradiance / Beer law form
I=I0exp(-τm)
Plaintext: I = I0 * exp(-tau * m)

Source / 출처: NASA TM-102299 is cited in MarsLab/marslab/environment/light_intensity.py.

Diffuse fraction

Diffuse fraction is modeled as a tau-driven approximation.

Diffuse approximation
fraction=interp(τ,table)
Plaintext: fraction = interp(tau, table)

Source / 출처: MarsLab/marslab/environment/diffuse_fraction.py gives the repository reference status.

Sky dome

Sky dome helper maps atmospheric state to dome rendering parameters.

Dome parameters
params=f(τ,sunElevation)
Plaintext: params = f(tau, sun_elevation)

Source / 출처: MarsLab/marslab/environment/sky_dome.py docstring cites repository source text.

Wheel/body odometry math

Odometry math rotates world-frame linear/angular velocities into the body frame.

Body twist
vbody=R(q-1)vworld
Plaintext: linear_body = R(q_current^-1) * linear_world

Source / 출처: 출처가 저장소에 명시되지 않음 / No formal citation given in repository

Quaternion conventions

Quaternion helper centralizes scalar-first [w,x,y,z] ZYX RPY conventions.

ZYX RPY quaternion
w=crcpcy+srspsy;z=crcpsy-srspcy
Plaintext: w=cr cp cy + sr sp sy; z=cr cp sy - sr sp cy

Source / 출처: 출처가 저장소에 명시되지 않음 / No formal citation given in repository

GT/TUM trajectory dump

GT odometry callback writes timestamp, translation, and quaternion to TUM text.

TUM pose line
line=t,tx,ty,tz,qx,qy,qz,qw
Plaintext: t tx ty tz qx qy qz qw

Source / 출처: TUM format and evo usage are named in TUMEvaluation README and source.

ATE/RPE metrics via evo

The wrapper delegates absolute pose error computation to evo CLI.

ATE invocation
ATE=evo_ape(GT,EST)
Plaintext: evo_ape tum GT EST --align [--correct_scale]

Source / 출처: evo repository link is cited in TUMEvaluation/README.md.

- **50 m ≤ D < 1 km** → `Watters2015_Crater` (small Mars craters), d/D = 0.175MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/REPORT.md:82
- **`data/astromaterials/sample_*/`** — NASA Astromaterials photogrammetryMarsLab-Utils/RockAssetGen/README.md:85
- **`Hartmann_Neukum_2001` requires `a ≥ 10`**: Documented constraint from Neukum 2001 valid range. CraterComposer falls back to power-law for `min_diameter_m < 10`.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/REPORT.md:137
- **Caveat**: Hartmann's "isochron" approach (Hartmann 2005, Icarus 174) uses DIFFERENT coefficients than Neukum 2001. Our implementation explicitly follows the **Neukum side** of H&N 2001 (the joint paper presents both Hartmann's isochrons and Neukum's polynomial). The docstring notes the two approaches "agree within ~10 percent" per H&N 2001 Fig. 6.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/SCIENTIFIC_VERIFICATION.md:86
- **Central peak**: For D ≥ ~7 km Mars craters transition from simple bowl to complex (with central peak). Implementation uses bowl polynomial for ALL D. For the user's scene generation (max D ~100 m in Scene B), this is irrelevant — all craters are well below the simple-to-complex transition (~7 km on Mars per Robbins & Hynek 2012 Paper 2).MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/SCIENTIFIC_VERIFICATION.md:45

- Hartmann & Neukum 2001 use Neukum's polynomial fit for the Mars Production Function (MPF). Our `Hartmann_Neukum_2001` class uses the **same polynomial coefficients as the lunar NPF** (lines 471–488 of `Coef_Distribution`). This is scientifically defensible because Neukum's MPF and LPF polynomials share identical coefficients in the "log–log production rate" form (the difference between Moon and Mars is in the chronology calibration, not the polynomial shape). H&N 2001 Section 2.2 explicitly applies the Neukum production polynomial to Mars with this assumption.MarsLab-Utils/CraterComposer/SCIENTIFIC_VERIFICATION.md:85

1. **CRITICAL — Stream 1 (PathFollower):** `make_follower_class()` constructs `type("SlamBench", (rclpy.node.Node,), dict(SlamBench.__dict__))`. Because `SlamBench` already does `rclpy.node.Node.__init__(self, ...)` inside its own `__init__`, the resulting `SlamBench(rclpy.node.Node)` subclass calls `Node.__init__` twice on the same instance once `make_follower_class` is used at runtime. The offline test passes only because the stub `_Node.__init__` is idempotent. Under live ROS 2 this raises `RuntimeError: Node already initialized` on second call. See `PathFollower/src/pathfollower/follower_node.py:55-65` + `:283-285`. Switch to a regular `class SlamBench(Node):` (with a runtime-side `from rclpy.node import Node`) or have the class call `super().__init__` instead of `Node.__init__`.MarsLab-Utils/.omc/research/task8-code-review.md:17

> **TL;DR**: HQ exports (`visual_grid_size: 2049` + `max_texture_size_px: 20000` + multi-scale `detail_variation`) peak at **25–35 GiB** RAM, even for a 1 km × 1 km crop. The pipeline is built around in-memory full-array operations (lanczos resampling, multi-scale noise synthesis, USD prim authoring) that cannot stream without code restructuring. Disk I/O for the resulting `terrain_scene.usda` (~1 GB) and OBJ debug exports (~380 MB each) is also single-threaded text, which is why low-memory runs can still take minutes.MarsLab-Utils/docs/MemoryIssue.md:3

Defaults match but if a user reads JSON kinematics and wants to override them on the CLI, there's no validation that `v-target ≤ v-max ≤ trajectory.kinematics.v_lin_mps`. | Add a sanity check at startup (or at least a warning) that compares CLI v-max / w-max against the matching fields in `trajectory.json` if it exists side-by-side with the TUM file. | MEDIUM | tmp/gt_tum_dumper/gt_dumper.py:36 | `open(args.output, "w")` defaults to text mode, no `encoding=` argument. On POSIX this defaults to UTF-8 but on Windows it depends on locale (cp949 in Korean locale, which would mangle nothing here since the content is ASCII, but it's a hidden assumption). | Specify `encoding="utf-8"` explicitly to make the file's byte content portable. (Same nit applies to `TUMEvaluation/src/tumevaluation/gt_dumper_node.py:42` — that one is already `encoding="utf-8"` ✓.) |MarsLab-Utils/.omc/research/task8-code-review.md:105
| MEDIUM | tmp/gt_tum_dumper/gt_dumper.py:49-51 | `self._file.flush()` only fires every 100 messages. The README says "flushes immediately, so the file is safe even on abrupt termination" — but that's TUMEvaluation's behavior. The temp dumper batches by 100 to reduce I/O overhead, so a SIGKILL between flushes loses up to 100 poses (~2 seconds at 50 Hz). | Either flush every message (matches TUMEvaluation, simpler invariant) or rename to make the 100-message buffer obvious. The signal handler at line 69-71 does `flush_and_close()` so SIGINT/SIGTERM is safe; only SIGKILL or hard crash loses data. |MarsLab-Utils/.omc/research/task8-code-review.md:106
| MEDIUM | tmp/gt_tum_dumper/gt_dumper.py:67-81 | `signal.signal(SIGINT, _shutdown)` registers a custom handler that calls `node.flush_and_close(); rclpy.shutdown(); sys.exit(0)`. But the `try…finally` block also calls `node.flush_and_close()` — so on SIGINT, `flush_and_close` runs twice: once from the signal handler (which then `sys.exit`s), and *not* from the `finally`. Because `sys.exit` raises `SystemExit` and bypasses `finally` in the C signal frame, it's actually fine — but the dual-cleanup design is fragile. | Pick one path. Either keep the signal handler and remove the `finally` flush, or rely on `rclpy.spin`'s KeyboardInterrupt and drop the explicit signal.signal registration. |MarsLab-Utils/.omc/research/task8-code-review.md:107
| MEDIUM | TUMEvaluation/src/tumevaluation/evo_wrapper.py:44-51 | `_parse_evo_stats` uses a regex `rf"{key}\s+([0-9eE+\-\.]+)"`. evo's table output is tab-separated and the regex's `\s+` happily captures the tab plus the value, but it also matches keys substring-of-longer-keys: `mean` will match a line like `mean[m]` if evo's output ever adds units to the key. | Tighten the regex to `^\s*{key}\b\s+([0-9eE+\-\.]+)` with `re.MULTILINE`. evo's TUM-mode output is currently safe but the look isn't future-proof. |MarsLab-Utils/.omc/research/task8-code-review.md:37

Confirmed by the offline test output: `msg 2: ... -0.000000 -0.000000 -0.000000 1.000000`. | Compare `qw < 0.0` is fine for the canonical flip but the negative-zero components are cosmetically ugly.
